summary: BitFuFu Inc. filed a Form 6-K updating its pending acquisition of 51% of Uni-Titan LLC, owner of a 51-megawatt Oklahoma Bitcoin mining facility, under a definitive agreement dated February 19, 2025. On September 28, 2026, CFIUS notified the company it found no unresolved national security concerns, and the transaction parties signed a national security agreement with DHS and Treasury imposing use restrictions, hardware deployment limits, prior-approval requirements on improvements, and ongoing compliance governance. No price, premium or closing date is disclosed; watch CFIUS-mandated operating constraints and timing of closing.
